words.exampleTranslation: I'm going to post a photo of dinner.
words.proTip: In PT-PT, 'publicar' = to post online. Never use 'postar' — that's Brazilian Portuguese.

words.example: Deixei um comentário na tua foto.
words.exampleTranslation: I left a comment on your photo.

words.example: Envia-me uma mensagem quando chegares.
words.exampleTranslation: Send me a message when you arrive.

words.example: Recebi uma notificação no telemóvel.
words.exampleTranslation: I received a notification on my phone.

words.example: Vou pesquisar no Google.
words.exampleTranslation: I'm going to search on Google.

words.example: Clica neste botão.
words.exampleTranslation: Click on this button.

words.example: Copia o endereço e cola aqui.
words.exampleTranslation: Copy the address and paste it here.

words.example: Não te esqueças de guardar o ficheiro.
words.exampleTranslation: Don't forget to save the file.

words.example: Apaguei a mensagem sem querer.
words.exampleTranslation: I accidentally deleted the message.
words.proTip: 'Apagar' also means 'to turn off' (a light) or 'to erase.' 'Apagar um ficheiro' = delete a file.

words.example: Preciso de atualizar o sistema.
words.exampleTranslation: I need to update the system.

words.example: Podes enviar-me o link?
words.exampleTranslation: Can you send me the link?

words.example: Já recebi o teu email.
words.exampleTranslation: I already received your email.

words.example: Esqueci-me da minha palavra-passe.
words.exampleTranslation: I forgot my password.
words.proTip: European Portuguese always says 'palavra-passe.' Never use 'senha' — that's Brazilian Portuguese.

words.example: Qual é o teu nome de utilizador?
words.exampleTranslation: What's your username?

words.example: Tens de iniciar sessão primeiro.
words.exampleTranslation: You have to log in first.

words.example: Não te esqueças de terminar sessão.
words.exampleTranslation: Don't forget to log out.

words.example: Abre o ficheiro que te enviei.
words.exampleTranslation: Open the file I sent you.
words.proTip: In PT-PT, always say 'ficheiro' for a digital file. 'Arquivo' means archive. In Brazil, 'arquivo' is used for both.

words.example: Este portátil tem ecrã tátil.
words.exampleTranslation: This laptop has a touchscreen.

words.example: Aqui não há sinal.
words.exampleTranslation: There's no signal here.

words.example: Queres tirar uma fotografia?
words.exampleTranslation: Do you want to take a photo?
words.proTip: 'Fotografia' is the formal word; 'foto' is the everyday short form. Both are feminine: 'a fotografia,' 'a foto.'

words.example: Viste o vídeo que te enviei?
words.exampleTranslation: Did you see the video I sent you?

words.example: Liga o computador, por favor.
words.exampleTranslation: Turn on the computer, please.

relatedWords.meaning: to turn off / to hang up

words.proTip: 'Ligar' = turn on (device), call someone, or connect. 'Desligar' = turn off or hang up. 'Liga-me!' = Call me!

words.english: to turn off / to hang up
words.example: Desliga o telemóvel durante o filme.
words.exampleTranslation: Turn off your phone during the movie.

words.example: Que navegador usas?
words.exampleTranslation: Which browser do you use?

words.example: A inteligência artificial está a mudar tudo.
words.exampleTranslation: Artificial intelligence is changing everything.

words.example: Os dados estão no telemóvel.
words.exampleTranslation: The data is on the phone.

words.example: Preciso de criar uma conta.
words.exampleTranslation: I need to create an account.

words.example: Vou bloquear esse número.
words.exampleTranslation: I'm going to block that number.

words.example: Viste a notícia de hoje?
words.exampleTranslation: Did you see today's news?

words.example: Li um artigo interessante.
words.exampleTranslation: I read an interesting article.

words.example: Qual é o teu programa favorito?
words.exampleTranslation: What's your favourite programme?

words.example: Ouço rádio no carro.
words.exampleTranslation: I listen to the radio in the car.

words.example: Muda de canal.
words.exampleTranslation: Change the channel.

words.example: Vi o anúncio na televisão.
words.exampleTranslation: I saw the advert on TV.

words.example: O telefone está a tocar.
words.exampleTranslation: The phone is ringing.

words.example: Tenho de fazer uma chamada.
words.exampleTranslation: I have to make a phone call.

words.example: Dá-me o teu contacto.
words.exampleTranslation: Give me your contact details.

words.example: Tivemos uma conversa longa.
words.exampleTranslation: We had a long conversation.

words.example: Qual é a tua opinião?
words.exampleTranslation: What's your opinion?

words.example: Tenho uma ideia!
words.exampleTranslation: I have an idea!

words.example: Tivemos uma discussão sobre política.
words.exampleTranslation: We had a discussion about politics.

words.example: Concordo contigo.
words.exampleTranslation: I agree with you.

words.example: Discordo completamente.
words.exampleTranslation: I completely disagree.

words.example: Podes explicar-me?
words.exampleTranslation: Can you explain to me?

words.example: Descreve o que aconteceu.
words.exampleTranslation: Describe what happened.

words.example: Prometo que venho amanhã.
words.exampleTranslation: I promise I'll come tomorrow.

words.example: Vou avisar a Maria.
words.exampleTranslation: I'll let Maria know.

words.example: Vou informar o chefe.
words.exampleTranslation: I'll inform the boss.

words.example: Peço desculpa pelo atraso.
words.exampleTranslation: I apologise for the delay.

words.example: Ouço um podcast sobre Portugal.
words.exampleTranslation: I listen to a podcast about Portugal.

words.example: Vemos filmes em streaming.
words.exampleTranslation: We watch films on streaming.

words.example: A loja está online.
words.exampleTranslation: The shop is online.

words.example: A aplicação funciona offline.
words.exampleTranslation: The app works offline.

words.example: Mudei de tarifário e agora pago menos por mês.
words.exampleTranslation: I changed my plan and now I pay less a month.
words.proTip: Most home bundles come with a 24-month «fidelização»; cancelling early costs money.

words.example: Fiquei sem dados móveis a meio do mês.
words.exampleTranslation: I ran out of mobile data halfway through the month.

words.example: Manda-me uma captura de ecrã da mensagem de erro.
words.exampleTranslation: Send me a screenshot of the error message.
words.proTip: In casual speech most people just say «um print».

words.example: Deixei-te uma mensagem de voz no WhatsApp.
words.exampleTranslation: I left you a voice message on WhatsApp.

words.example: Faço uma videochamada com os meus pais todos os domingos.
words.exampleTranslation: I video call my parents every Sunday.

words.example: Faz uma cópia de segurança antes de atualizar o telemóvel.
words.exampleTranslation: Back up before updating your phone.

words.example: O portátil avariou e está na assistência técnica.
words.exampleTranslation: The laptop broke down and it's at the repair service.

words.example: Passa-me os ficheiros para esta pen, por favor.
words.exampleTranslation: Put the files on this USB stick for me, please.
words.proTip: In Portugal a USB flash drive is simply «uma pen».

words.example: Põe o telemóvel em modo de avião durante a descolagem.
words.exampleTranslation: Put your phone on airplane mode during take-off.

words.example: Vai às definições e desliga as notificações.
words.exampleTranslation: Go to settings and turn off notifications.

words.example: Fiz um carregamento de dez euros no multibanco.
words.exampleTranslation: I topped up ten euros at the cash machine.
words.proTip: You can top up a prepaid phone at any Multibanco machine under «Carregamentos».

words.example: Tens de instalar a aplicação do banco.
words.exampleTranslation: You have to install the bank's app.

words.example: Se não funcionar, experimenta reiniciar o router.
words.exampleTranslation: If it doesn't work, try restarting the router.

relatedWords.meaning: turn it off and on again

words.example: Recebi um código de verificação por SMS.
words.exampleTranslation: I got a verification code by text.

words.example: No comboio para Sintra fico sempre sem rede.
words.exampleTranslation: On the train to Sintra I always lose signal.

words.example: O apartamento já tem fibra instalada.
words.exampleTranslation: The flat already has fibre installed.

words.example: Liguei para o operador por causa da internet.
words.exampleTranslation: I called the provider about the internet.
words.proTip: The big three are MEO, NOS and Vodafone; Digi has shaken up prices recently.

words.example: Vê na caixa de entrada e também no spam.
words.exampleTranslation: Check your inbox and the spam folder too.

words.example: Podes reencaminhar-me o email da senhoria?
words.exampleTranslation: Can you forward me the landlady's email?

words.example: Preciso de imprimir o contrato antes da reunião.
words.exampleTranslation: I need to print the contract before the meeting.

categories.title: Clothing & Appearance
categories.description: Camisa, sapatos, vestido — clothing, style, and describing how people look.

words.example: Vou vestir a camisa azul.
words.exampleTranslation: I'm going to wear the blue shirt.

words.example: Leva uma camisola, está frio.
words.exampleTranslation: Bring a sweater, it's cold.
words.proTip: 'Camisola' in PT-PT means sweater/jumper. In Brazil, 'camisola' means nightgown — very different!

words.example: Comprei uma t-shirt nova.
words.exampleTranslation: I bought a new T-shirt.

words.example: Não saias sem casaco.
words.exampleTranslation: Don't go out without a coat.

words.example: Leva o blusão, pode chover.
words.exampleTranslation: Bring the jacket, it might rain.

words.example: Ele usou um colete por cima da camisa.
words.exampleTranslation: He wore a waistcoat over the shirt.

words.example: Preciso de um fato para a entrevista.
words.exampleTranslation: I need a suit for the interview.
words.proTip: 'Fato' = suit (formal). 'Fato de banho' = swimsuit. 'Fato de treino' = tracksuit. In Brazil, 'fato' means 'fact' — in PT-PT it's primarily 'suit.'

words.example: Que vestido bonito!
words.exampleTranslation: What a beautiful dress!
words.proTip: Even though it's clothing worn by women, 'vestido' is masculine: 'o vestido.'

words.example: Estas calças estão muito apertadas.
words.exampleTranslation: These trousers are too tight.
words.proTip: 'Calças' is always plural in Portuguese — you never say 'calça' (singular) for trousers.

words.example: No verão uso sempre calções.
words.exampleTranslation: In summer I always wear shorts.

words.example: A saia preta combina com tudo.
words.exampleTranslation: The black skirt goes with everything.

words.example: As calças de ganga são muito confortáveis.
words.exampleTranslation: Jeans are very comfortable.
words.proTip: 'Ganga' = denim. In PT-PT, jeans are always 'calças de ganga.' You might hear 'jeans' too, but 'calças de ganga' is the proper term.

words.example: Preciso de sapatos novos.
words.exampleTranslation: I need new shoes.

words.example: Vou calçar os ténis para correr.
words.exampleTranslation: I'm going to put on my trainers to run.
words.proTip: In PT-PT, 'ténis' means both the sport (tennis) and sneakers/trainers. 'Sapatilhas' is also used for trainers.

words.example: No inverno uso sempre botas.
words.exampleTranslation: In winter I always wear boots.

words.example: Na praia uso sandálias.
words.exampleTranslation: At the beach I wear sandals.

words.example: Em casa ando sempre de chinelos.
words.exampleTranslation: At home I always wear slippers.
words.proTip: 'Chinelos' can mean both slippers (indoor) and flip-flops (beach). Context clarifies.

words.example: Põe o chapéu, está muito sol.
words.exampleTranslation: Put on your hat, it's very sunny.

words.example: Leva um lenço para o pescoço.
words.exampleTranslation: Bring a scarf for your neck.

words.example: Precisas de um cinto com estas calças.
words.exampleTranslation: You need a belt with these trousers.

words.example: Onde estão os meus óculos?
words.exampleTranslation: Where are my glasses?
words.proTip: 'Óculos' is always plural. 'Usar óculos' = to wear glasses.

words.example: Esqueci-me dos óculos de sol.
words.exampleTranslation: I forgot my sunglasses.

words.example: Que relógio giro!
words.exampleTranslation: What a cool watch!
words.proTip: 'Relógio' means both wristwatch and clock. 'Relógio de pulso' = wristwatch. 'Relógio de parede' = wall clock.

words.example: Gosto muito desses brincos.
words.exampleTranslation: I really like those earrings.

words.example: Ela usa sempre o mesmo colar.
words.exampleTranslation: She always wears the same necklace.
words.proTip: Same spelling as 'colar' (to paste/to glue) — context makes it clear. As a noun with article: 'o colar' = the necklace.

words.example: A pulseira é de prata.
words.exampleTranslation: The bracelet is made of silver.

words.example: Que anel bonito! É de ouro?
words.exampleTranslation: What a beautiful ring! Is it gold?

words.example: Leva a mala, tens lá tudo.
words.exampleTranslation: Bring the bag, you have everything in there.
words.proTip: 'Mala' in PT-PT means handbag/purse (everyday) or suitcase (travel). 'Mala de mão' = handbag, 'mala de viagem' = suitcase.

words.example: Estás muito bonita hoje.
words.exampleTranslation: You look very pretty today.

words.example: Aquele casaco é muito feio.
words.exampleTranslation: That coat is very ugly.

words.example: Estás muito elegante com esse fato.
words.exampleTranslation: You look very smart in that suit.

words.example: Prefiro um estilo mais casual.
words.exampleTranslation: I prefer a more casual style.

words.example: Gosto desta camisa estampada.
words.exampleTranslation: I like this patterned shirt.

words.example: Prefiro t-shirts lisas, sem desenhos.
words.exampleTranslation: I prefer plain T-shirts, without designs.

words.example: Aquela camisola às riscas é gira.
words.exampleTranslation: That striped jumper is cool.

words.example: Tens uma saia às bolinhas?
words.exampleTranslation: Do you have a polka-dot skirt?

words.example: Estas calças estão muito largas.
words.exampleTranslation: These trousers are too loose.

words.example: Esta camisola está muito apertada.
words.exampleTranslation: This jumper is too tight.

words.example: Gosto de vestidos mais justos.
words.exampleTranslation: I like more fitted dresses.

words.example: Despe o casaco, está calor aqui.
words.exampleTranslation: Take off your coat, it's hot in here.

words.example: Calça os sapatos, vamos sair.
words.exampleTranslation: Put your shoes on, we're going out.
words.proTip: 'Calçar' is specifically for footwear. 'Vestir' is for clothing. Portuguese distinguishes the two — you never 'vestir' shoes.

words.example: Em casa, descalço os sapatos à entrada.
words.exampleTranslation: At home, I take off my shoes at the door.

words.example: Posso provar isto?
words.exampleTranslation: Can I try this on?
words.proTip: 'Provar' = try on (clothes) or taste (food). 'Experimentar' also works for both, but 'provar' is more common for clothes in shops.

words.example: Esta gravata não combina com a camisa.
words.exampleTranslation: This tie doesn't go with the shirt.
words.proTip: 'Combinar' also means 'to arrange/agree' (e.g., 'Vamos combinar um dia' = Let's arrange a day). For clothes: 'combinar com' = to match/go with.

words.example: Preciso de comprar roupa nova.
words.exampleTranslation: I need to buy new clothes.
words.proTip: 'Roupa' is always singular in Portuguese, even when referring to multiple items. 'Muita roupa' = many clothes.

words.example: As chaves estão no bolso.
words.exampleTranslation: The keys are in the pocket.

words.example: Falta um botão nesta camisa.
words.exampleTranslation: There's a button missing on this shirt.

words.example: O fecho do casaco está preso.
words.exampleTranslation: The coat zipper is stuck.
words.proTip: 'Fecho' or 'fecho éclair' — both are used in PT-PT for zipper.

words.example: Que número calças?
words.exampleTranslation: What shoe size do you wear?
words.proTip: For shoes: 'número' (Que número calças? = What size?). For clothes: 'tamanho.' Two different words!

words.example: Onde é o provador?
words.exampleTranslation: Where is the fitting room?

words.example: Tens de usar gravata no escritório?
words.exampleTranslation: Do you have to wear a tie at the office?

words.example: Preciso de meias limpas.
words.exampleTranslation: I need clean socks.

words.example: Leva roupa interior suficiente para a viagem.
words.exampleTranslation: Bring enough underwear for the trip.

words.english: it suits you / it looks good on you
words.example: Esse vestido fica-te muito bem!
words.exampleTranslation: That dress looks great on you!
words.proTip: 'Fica-te bem' (informal you) / 'Fica-lhe bem' (formal). To say it looks bad: 'Não te fica bem' or 'Fica-te mal.'

words.example: Leva um casaco de malha, que à noite arrefece.
words.exampleTranslation: Take a cardigan, it gets cold at night.

words.example: Para andar em Lisboa, sapatilhas confortáveis são essenciais.
words.exampleTranslation: For walking around Lisbon, comfy trainers are essential.

words.example: Comprei um cachecol do Benfica para o meu sobrinho.
words.exampleTranslation: I bought a Benfica scarf for my nephew.

words.example: Em Trás-os-Montes no inverno precisas mesmo de luvas.
words.exampleTranslation: In Trás-os-Montes in winter you really need gloves.
words.proTip: Gloves, like shoes, are «calçadas», not «vestidas»: «calça as luvas».

words.example: Essas calças largas voltaram a estar na moda.
words.exampleTranslation: Those baggy trousers are back in fashion.

words.example: Põe o gorro, que está um frio de rachar.
words.exampleTranslation: Put your beanie on, it's freezing.

words.example: Não te esqueças do fato de banho e da toalha.
words.exampleTranslation: Don't forget your swimsuit and towel.
words.proTip: «Fato» in Portugal is a suit; «fato de banho» is a swimsuit and «fato de treino» a tracksuit.

words.example: Esse casaco assenta-te mesmo bem nos ombros.
words.exampleTranslation: That jacket fits you really well on the shoulders.

words.example: Ao domingo passo o dia de fato de treino.
words.exampleTranslation: On Sundays I spend the day in my tracksuit.

words.example: Em novembro uso a gabardina quase todos os dias.
words.exampleTranslation: In November I wear my trench coat almost every day.

words.example: As calças são compridas, tenho de fazer a bainha.
words.exampleTranslation: The trousers are long, I need to get them hemmed.

words.example: Levei o vestido à costureira para o apertar.
words.exampleTranslation: I took the dress to the seamstress to take it in.
words.proTip: Neighbourhood shops with a sign «Arranjos de costura» do hems and repairs cheaply.

words.example: Ainda estou de pijama e já é meio-dia.
words.exampleTranslation: I'm still in my pyjamas and it's already midday.
words.proTip: Note it's singular in Portuguese: «o pijama».

words.example: Pendura a camisa num cabide para não amarrotar.
words.exampleTranslation: Hang the shirt on a hanger so it doesn't crease.

words.example: Vê na etiqueta se pode ir à máquina.
words.exampleTranslation: Check the label to see if it can go in the machine.

categories.title: Opposites
categories.description: Common antonym pairs for adjectives, verbs, adverbs, and nouns — learn words in pairs for faster recall.

words.example: A casa é muito grande.
words.exampleTranslation: The house is very big.
words.proTip: In EP, 'grande' before a noun can mean 'great' rather than 'big': 'um grande homem' (a great man) vs 'um homem grande' (a big/tall man).

words.example: O jardim é pequeno mas bonito.
words.exampleTranslation: The garden is small but pretty.
words.proTip: 'Pequenino' is a common affectionate diminutive used especially when talking to or about children.

words.example: O café está muito quente.
words.exampleTranslation: The coffee is very hot.

words.example: Está muito frio lá fora.
words.exampleTranslation: It's very cold outside.
words.proTip: 'Frio' is both an adjective (cold) and a noun (the cold): 'Tenho frio' (I'm cold — literally 'I have cold').

words.example: Ele é muito alto.
words.exampleTranslation: He is very tall.

words.example: A mesa é muito baixa.
words.exampleTranslation: The table is very low.
words.proTip: 'Baixo' also means 'bass' in music. And 'em baixo' / 'embaixo' means 'below' or 'downstairs'.

words.example: Comprámos um carro novo.
words.exampleTranslation: We bought a new car.
words.proTip: 'Novo' has two meanings: 'new' (for things) and 'young' (for people). Context makes it clear: 'uma casa nova' (a new house) vs 'ela é nova' (she is young).

words.example: Este edifício é muito velho.
words.exampleTranslation: This building is very old.
words.proTip: For people, 'idoso' is more polite than 'velho'. Calling someone 'velho' can sound rude. For objects, 'velho' is fine.

words.example: Que dia tão bonito!
words.exampleTranslation: What a beautiful day!
words.proTip: 'Giro/gira' is a very common EP word for cute/pretty/cool. It's used casually: 'Que giro!' (How cute!). Brazilians don't use this word.

words.example: Aquele quadro é feio.
words.exampleTranslation: That painting is ugly.

words.example: O exame foi fácil.
words.exampleTranslation: The exam was easy.

words.example: Português é difícil mas não é impossível.
words.exampleTranslation: Portuguese is difficult but it's not impossible.

words.example: O comboio é muito rápido.
words.exampleTranslation: The train is very fast.
words.proTip: In EP, 'rápido' is mainly an adjective. As an adverb ('quickly'), European Portuguese prefers 'depressa': 'Anda depressa!' (Come quickly!).

words.example: O serviço neste restaurante é lento.
words.exampleTranslation: The service in this restaurant is slow.
words.proTip: The adverb form is 'devagar' (slowly) or 'lentamente'. 'Devagar' is much more common in spoken EP.

words.example: A cozinha está limpa.
words.exampleTranslation: The kitchen is clean.

words.example: As mãos estão sujas.
words.exampleTranslation: The hands are dirty.

words.example: O autocarro está cheio.
words.exampleTranslation: The bus is full.
words.proTip: 'Cheio' is also used colloquially to mean 'fed up': 'Estou cheio disto!' (I'm fed up with this!).

words.example: O restaurante estava vazio.
words.exampleTranslation: The restaurant was empty.

words.example: Ele é muito forte.
words.exampleTranslation: He is very strong.

words.example: Sinto-me fraco hoje.
words.exampleTranslation: I feel weak today.
words.proTip: 'Fraco' is also used for bad quality: 'O filme foi fraco' (The film was poor/weak).

words.example: Portugal é rico em história.
words.exampleTranslation: Portugal is rich in history.

words.example: O bairro é pobre mas tem muita vida.
words.exampleTranslation: The neighbourhood is poor but has a lot of life.
words.proTip: 'Pobre' before a noun changes meaning: 'o homem pobre' (the poor man — no money) vs 'o pobre homem' (the poor man — unfortunate/pitiful).

words.example: O gato está a ficar gordo.
words.exampleTranslation: The cat is getting fat.

words.example: Ela é muito magra.
words.exampleTranslation: She is very thin.

words.example: A rua é muito larga.
words.exampleTranslation: The street is very wide.
words.proTip: 'Largo' as a noun means a small square/plaza: 'o Largo do Carmo' is a famous square in Lisbon.

words.example: As ruas da Alfama são muito estreitas.
words.exampleTranslation: The streets of Alfama are very narrow.

words.example: A mala é leve.
words.exampleTranslation: The suitcase is light.

words.example: Esta caixa é muito pesada.
words.exampleTranslation: This box is very heavy.
words.proTip: 'Pesado' is also used informally to mean 'heavy/intense' emotionally: 'O filme foi pesado' (The film was heavy/intense).

words.example: Podes abrir a janela?
words.exampleTranslation: Can you open the window?

words.example: Fecha a porta, está frio.
words.exampleTranslation: Close the door, it's cold.

words.example: Vou comprar pão.
words.exampleTranslation: I'm going to buy bread.

words.example: Ele quer vender a casa.
words.exampleTranslation: He wants to sell the house.

words.example: Temos de subir as escadas.
words.exampleTranslation: We have to go up the stairs.

words.example: Cuidado ao descer as escadas.
words.exampleTranslation: Be careful going down the stairs.

words.example: Posso entrar?
words.exampleTranslation: May I come in?

words.example: Vamos sair às oito.
words.exampleTranslation: We're going out at eight.
words.proTip: In EP, 'sair' is used for both leaving a place and going out socially: 'Queres sair logo à noite?' (Do you want to go out tonight?).

words.example: O filme começa às nove.
words.exampleTranslation: The film starts at nine.

words.example: A aula acaba às cinco.
words.exampleTranslation: The class finishes at five.
words.proTip: 'Acabar de + infinitive' means 'to have just done something': 'Acabei de comer' (I just ate).

words.example: Portugal ganhou o Europeu em 2016.
words.exampleTranslation: Portugal won the Euros in 2016.
words.proTip: 'Ganhar' means both 'to win' and 'to earn (money)': 'Quanto ganhas por mês?' (How much do you earn per month?).

words.example: Perdi as chaves outra vez.
words.exampleTranslation: I lost the keys again.
words.proTip: 'Perder' covers both 'to lose' (a game, keys) and 'to miss' (a bus, a flight): 'Perdi o comboio' (I missed the train).

words.example: Lembras-te do nome dele?
words.exampleTranslation: Do you remember his name?
words.proTip: In EP, 'lembrar-se' (reflexive) is the standard form: 'Eu lembro-me' (I remember). Without the reflexive, it means 'to remind': 'Lembra-me amanhã' (Remind me tomorrow).

words.example: Esqueci-me do aniversário dela.
words.exampleTranslation: I forgot her birthday.
words.proTip: Like 'lembrar', 'esquecer' is usually reflexive in EP: 'esqueci-me de...' (I forgot about...).

words.example: Dá-me o sal, por favor.
words.exampleTranslation: Give me the salt, please.

words.example: Recebi uma carta hoje.
words.exampleTranslation: I received a letter today.

words.example: Ela chega sempre a horas.
words.exampleTranslation: She always arrives on time.

words.example: Nunca fui ao Brasil.
words.exampleTranslation: I've never been to Brazil.
words.proTip: When 'nunca' comes before the verb, you don't need 'não': 'Nunca fui' (I never went). But 'Não fui nunca' (I didn't ever go) is also correct — double negatives are fine in Portuguese.

words.example: Cheguei antes de ti.
words.exampleTranslation: I arrived before you.

words.example: Falamos depois do jantar.
words.exampleTranslation: We'll talk after dinner.

words.example: O gato está cá dentro.
words.exampleTranslation: The cat is in here.

words.example: Vamos comer lá fora.
words.exampleTranslation: Let's eat outside.
words.proTip: 'Cá dentro' (in here) and 'lá fora' (out there) are extremely common EP expressions. You'll hear them constantly.

words.example: O fado é muito popular.
words.exampleTranslation: Fado is very popular.

words.example: A receita é muito simples.
words.exampleTranslation: The recipe is very simple.

words.example: A gramática portuguesa é complicada.
words.exampleTranslation: Portuguese grammar is complicated.

words.example: Esta estrada é perigosa à noite.
words.exampleTranslation: This road is dangerous at night.

words.example: A aldeia é muito silenciosa.
words.exampleTranslation: The village is very quiet.

words.example: Os vizinhos são barulhentos.
words.exampleTranslation: The neighbours are noisy.

words.example: Ela é muito jovem.
words.exampleTranslation: She is very young.

words.example: O serviço foi muito profissional.
words.exampleTranslation: The service was very professional.

words.example: É uma questão pessoal.
words.exampleTranslation: It's a personal matter.

words.example: A próxima paragem é a minha.
words.exampleTranslation: The next stop is mine.

words.example: No dia seguinte fomos a Sintra.
words.exampleTranslation: The following day we went to Sintra.

words.example: O inquilino anterior era simpático.
words.exampleTranslation: The previous tenant was nice.

words.example: Este iogurte tem um sabor esquisito, acho que está estragado.
words.exampleTranslation: This yoghurt tastes strange, I think it's gone off.
words.proTip: False friend: esquisito never means 'exquisite'. Said of a person, it means fussy or picky — «ele é muito esquisito com a comida».

words.example: Está uma tarde muito agradável para uma esplanada.
words.exampleTranslation: It's a very pleasant afternoon for a café terrace.

words.example: Havia um cheiro muito desagradável no metro hoje.
words.exampleTranslation: There was a very unpleasant smell on the metro today.

words.example: Estes ténis são muito confortáveis para andar na calçada.
words.exampleTranslation: These trainers are very comfortable for walking on the cobbles.

words.example: A cadeira do escritório é tão desconfortável que me doem as costas.
words.exampleTranslation: The office chair is so uncomfortable that my back hurts.

words.example: Este remédio para a tosse é muito eficaz.
words.exampleTranslation: This cough remedy is very effective.

words.example: Os serviços online das Finanças são bastante eficientes.
words.exampleTranslation: The Finanças online services are quite efficient.

words.example: Esta aplicação é muito útil para ver os horários do comboio.
words.exampleTranslation: This app is very useful for checking train times.

words.example: É inútil ligar agora, a loja já fechou.
words.exampleTranslation: It's pointless calling now, the shop's already closed.

words.example: Felizmente o acidente não foi grave.
words.exampleTranslation: Luckily the accident wasn't serious.
words.proTip: Use grave for situations and injuries; for a serious person use sério.

words.example: Tenho uma ligeira dor de cabeça desde manhã.
words.exampleTranslation: I've had a slight headache since this morning.
words.proTip: On Portuguese road signs and documents, ligeiros means cars and pesados means lorries.

words.example: Havia uma fila enorme à porta da Loja do Cidadão.
words.exampleTranslation: There was a huge queue at the door of the Loja do Cidadão.

words.example: O apartamento é bonito, mas a cozinha é minúscula.
words.exampleTranslation: The flat is nice, but the kitchen is tiny.

words.example: Prefiro viver num bairro sossegado, longe da confusão.
words.exampleTranslation: I prefer living in a quiet neighbourhood, away from the hustle.
words.proTip: Fica sossegado is also what you say to calm someone down: 'don't worry, relax'.

words.example: É raro chover tanto em Lisboa em setembro.
words.exampleTranslation: It's rare for it to rain so much in Lisbon in September.

words.example: Simões é um apelido bastante comum em Portugal.
words.exampleTranslation: Simões is quite a common surname in Portugal.

words.example: Um guarda-chuva é essencial no inverno em Lisboa.
words.exampleTranslation: An umbrella is essential in winter in Lisbon.

words.example: É óbvio que ele não quer vir à festa.
words.exampleTranslation: It's obvious he doesn't want to come to the party.

words.example: Não é necessário marcar, podes aparecer quando quiseres.
words.exampleTranslation: There's no need to book, you can come whenever you want.

words.example: O galego é muito semelhante ao português.
words.exampleTranslation: Galician is very similar to Portuguese.

words.example: Ouvi um barulho estranho no carro esta manhã.
words.exampleTranslation: I heard a strange noise in the car this morning.

words.example: Cuidado, a água aqui é muito profunda.
words.exampleTranslation: Careful, the water here is very deep.

words.example: É impossível estacionar no Bairro Alto à noite.
words.exampleTranslation: It's impossible to park in Bairro Alto at night.

words.example: Viver perto do metro é muito prático.
words.exampleTranslation: Living near the metro is very handy.

words.example: Tu és muito parecido com o teu pai.
words.exampleTranslation: You look a lot like your father.

categories.title: Materials & Measurements
categories.description: Madeira, metal, vidro — materials, shapes, sizes, and units of measurement.

words.example: A mesa é de madeira.
words.exampleTranslation: The table is made of wood.

words.example: A porta é de metal.
words.exampleTranslation: The door is made of metal.

words.example: A garrafa é de vidro.
words.exampleTranslation: The bottle is made of glass.

words.example: Preciso de papel para a impressora.
words.exampleTranslation: I need paper for the printer.

words.example: O tecido é de algodão.
words.exampleTranslation: The fabric is cotton.

words.example: Prefiro roupa de algodão.
words.exampleTranslation: I prefer cotton clothes.

words.example: A camisola é de lã.
words.exampleTranslation: The sweater is made of wool.

words.example: Os sapatos são de couro.
words.exampleTranslation: The shoes are made of leather.

words.example: As botas são de borracha.
words.exampleTranslation: The boots are made of rubber.

words.example: O prato é de cerâmica.
words.exampleTranslation: The plate is ceramic.

words.example: Os azulejos são típicos de Portugal.
words.exampleTranslation: The tiles are typical of Portugal.

words.example: A mesa é redonda.
words.exampleTranslation: The table is round.

words.example: A caixa é quadrada.
words.exampleTranslation: The box is square.

words.example: O campo tem forma de retângulo.
words.exampleTranslation: The pitch is rectangular.

words.example: Desenha um triângulo.
words.exampleTranslation: Draw a triangle.

words.example: Sentámo-nos em círculo.
words.exampleTranslation: We sat in a circle.

words.example: Segue em frente, sempre reto.
words.exampleTranslation: Go straight ahead.

words.example: A estrada é curva.
words.exampleTranslation: The road is curved.

words.example: Qual é o comprimento da mesa?
words.exampleTranslation: What's the length of the table?

words.example: A largura do rio é de cem metros.
words.exampleTranslation: The width of the river is a hundred metres.

words.example: A torre tem cinquenta metros de altura.
words.exampleTranslation: The tower is fifty metres high.

words.example: Qual é o peso da mala?
words.exampleTranslation: What's the weight of the bag?

words.example: A prateleira tem trinta centímetros.
words.exampleTranslation: The shelf is thirty centimetres.

words.example: Lisboa fica a trezentos quilómetros.
words.exampleTranslation: Lisbon is three hundred kilometres away.

words.example: Quero meio quilograma de queijo.
words.exampleTranslation: I want half a kilogram of cheese.

words.example: Um litro de leite, por favor.
words.exampleTranslation: A litre of milk, please.

words.example: A distância é de dez quilómetros.
words.exampleTranslation: The distance is ten kilometres.

words.example: Em Lisboa, o metro quadrado está caríssimo.
words.exampleTranslation: In Lisbon, the price per square metre is sky-high.
words.proTip: Flat ads always give the size in m² — say «metros quadrados» out loud.

words.example: Queria duzentos gramas de fiambre, por favor.
words.exampleTranslation: I'd like two hundred grams of ham, please.
words.proTip: Strictly, the unit is masculine (duzentos gramas), but you'll often hear «duzentas gramas» at the deli counter; a grama is also grass.

words.example: Comprei uma dúzia de ovos no mercado.
words.exampleTranslation: I bought a dozen eggs at the market.
words.proTip: Eggs in Portugal are often sold by the dúzia or meia dúzia.

words.example: Mede a parede antes de comprarmos o sofá.
words.exampleTranslation: Measure the wall before we buy the sofa.
words.proTip: Medir is irregular: eu meço, tu medes. «Quanto medes?» = How tall are you?

words.example: Pode pesar-me esta fruta, por favor?
words.exampleTranslation: Could you weigh this fruit for me, please?

words.example: Subi à balança e assustei-me depois das férias.
words.exampleTranslation: I got on the scales and got a fright after the holidays.

words.example: A piscina tem dois metros de profundidade.
words.exampleTranslation: The pool is two metres deep.

words.example: Os talheres são de aço inoxidável.
words.exampleTranslation: The cutlery is stainless steel.

words.example: O portão é de ferro e está todo enferrujado.
words.exampleTranslation: The gate is iron and it's completely rusty.

words.example: Ela herdou um fio de ouro da avó.
words.exampleTranslation: She inherited a gold chain from her grandmother.
words.proTip: Portuguese gold filigree (filigrana) from the north is a classic gift.

words.example: Comprei uns brincos de prata na Feira da Ladra.
words.exampleTranslation: I bought some silver earrings at the Feira da Ladra.

words.example: Esta camisa é de seda, tem de ser lavada à mão.
words.exampleTranslation: This shirt is silk, it has to be hand-washed.

words.example: Portugal é o maior produtor de cortiça do mundo.
words.exampleTranslation: Portugal is the world's biggest cork producer.
words.proTip: A wine cork is a rolha; cortiça is the material.

words.example: No verão, prefiro calças de linho por causa do calor.
words.exampleTranslation: In summer, I prefer linen trousers because of the heat.

categories.title: Services & Bureaucracy
categories.description: Finanças, banks, post office, counters and paperwork — getting things done in Portugal

words.example: Tira uma senha e espera que chamem o teu número.
words.exampleTranslation: Take a ticket and wait for them to call your number.
words.proTip: At a counter, senha means the numbered paper ticket. For a computer password, people say palavra-passe (or also senha).

words.example: A fila para os correios hoje está enorme.
words.exampleTranslation: The queue at the post office is huge today.

words.example: Dirija-se ao balcão número três, por favor.
words.exampleTranslation: Please go to counter number three.
words.proTip: Banks also call a branch um balcão: «o balcão do Saldanha» means the Saldanha branch.

words.example: O guiché fecha à hora de almoço.
words.exampleTranslation: The window closes at lunchtime.

words.example: Tem de preencher este formulário antes de ser atendido.
words.exampleTranslation: You have to fill in this form before being served.

relatedWords.meaning: to fill in a printed form

words.example: Pode mostrar-me o cartão de cidadão, por favor?
words.exampleTranslation: Can you show me your citizen card, please?
words.proTip: The cartão de cidadão combines ID, NIF, Segurança Social and health numbers in one card. People often just say «o CC».

words.example: Qual é a sua morada completa?
words.exampleTranslation: What is your full address?
words.proTip: In Portugal «endereço» is mostly used for email or web addresses; your home address is a morada.

words.example: Quero abrir conta neste banco. O que é preciso?
words.exampleTranslation: I want to open an account at this bank. What do I need?

words.example: Introduza o código PIN e carregue em verde.
words.exampleTranslation: Enter your PIN and press the green button.

words.example: Chegou um pacote para ti, deixei-o na portaria.
words.exampleTranslation: A parcel arrived for you, I left it at the front desk.

words.example: Assine aqui e aqui, por favor.
words.exampleTranslation: Sign here and here, please.

words.example: Escreva a data de nascimento no formato dia, mês, ano.
words.exampleTranslation: Write your date of birth as day, month, year.

words.example: Pode soletrar o seu apelido, por favor?
words.exampleTranslation: Can you spell your surname, please?
words.proTip: False friend: apelido is your surname, not a nickname (that's alcunha). Portuguese people often have four or more names.

words.example: No formulário, pedem o estado civil e a profissão.
words.exampleTranslation: On the form, they ask for marital status and profession.

words.example: No campo da profissão, escrevi «engenheiro».
words.exampleTranslation: In the occupation field, I wrote 'engineer'.

words.example: Primeiro tens de tirar senha na máquina à entrada.
words.exampleTranslation: First you have to take a ticket from the machine at the entrance.
words.proTip: In Loja do Cidadão, Finanças and many banks, nobody serves you without a senha, even if the place looks empty.

words.example: Estou na fila há meia hora e ainda faltam vinte pessoas.
words.exampleTranslation: I've been in the queue for half an hour and there are still twenty people.

words.example: Bom dia, quem é o último? Ah, então fico atrás de si.
words.exampleTranslation: Good morning, who's last? Ah, then I'll stand behind you.
words.proTip: Where there are no tickets (pharmacies, cafés, small shops, health centres), Portuguese people ask this on arrival to keep track of the queue.

words.example: Desculpe, mas acho que é a minha vez.
words.exampleTranslation: Excuse me, but I think it's my turn.

words.example: Aguarde na sala de espera até ver o seu número.
words.exampleTranslation: Wait in the waiting room until you see your number.

words.english: to serve (a customer); to answer (the phone)
words.example: Já está a ser atendido ou posso ajudar?
words.exampleTranslation: Are you being served, or can I help?

words.example: A funcionária disse-me para voltar amanhã com o comprovativo.
words.exampleTranslation: The clerk told me to come back tomorrow with the proof.

words.example: O meu pedido ainda está a ser analisado.
words.exampleTranslation: My application is still being reviewed.

words.example: A entrega da encomenda está prevista para quinta-feira.
words.exampleTranslation: Delivery of the parcel is scheduled for Thursday.

words.example: Liguei para cancelar a marcação de amanhã.
words.exampleTranslation: I called to cancel tomorrow's appointment.
words.proTip: For appointments, Portuguese people often say desmarcar instead of cancelar.

words.example: Qual é o valor a pagar este mês?
words.exampleTranslation: What's the amount to pay this month?

words.example: Posso pagar com cartão ou só aceitam dinheiro?
words.exampleTranslation: Can I pay by card or do you only take cash?
words.proTip: Many small places will say «só aceitamos multibanco», meaning Portuguese debit cards, sometimes not foreign credit cards.

words.example: O seu passaporte ainda é válido até 2028.
words.exampleTranslation: Your passport is still valid until 2028.

words.example: Sem marcação, só atendem a partir das três.
words.exampleTranslation: Without an appointment, they only serve after three.
words.proTip: Most public services (Finanças, Segurança Social, AIMA) now work mainly by marcação, booked online or by phone.

words.example: Os serviços estão abertos ao público das nove às quatro.
words.exampleTranslation: The offices are open to the public from nine to four.

words.example: Fui à Loja do Cidadão renovar o cartão e tratar da carta.
words.exampleTranslation: I went to the Loja do Cidadão to renew my card and sort out my licence.
words.proTip: Loja do Cidadão gathers several services (Finanças, Segurança Social, IRN, utilities) under one roof. Arrive early: senhas often run out by mid-morning.

words.example: Podes pedir a segunda via no Portal das Finanças.
words.exampleTranslation: You can request the duplicate on the Portal das Finanças.
words.proTip: Almost everything tax-related (IRS, morada fiscal, e-fatura) can be done on the portal once you have your password, which arrives by post.

words.example: Quer o número de contribuinte na fatura?
words.exampleTranslation: Do you want your taxpayer number on the receipt?
words.proTip: You'll hear «Contribuinte?» at almost every till. Saying yes lets you deduct some expenses on your IRS.

words.example: Tens de atualizar a morada fiscal nas Finanças depois da mudança.
words.exampleTranslation: You have to update your tax address at Finanças after the move.

words.example: Como ainda vivo fora, preciso de um representante fiscal.
words.exampleTranslation: As I still live abroad, I need a tax representative.
words.proTip: Non-EU residents abroad usually need one to get a NIF; EU citizens generally don't.

words.example: Para começar a trabalhar, a empresa pediu-me o NISS.
words.exampleTranslation: To start working, the company asked me for my NISS.

words.example: Finalmente consegui marcação na AIMA para o mês que vem.
words.exampleTranslation: I finally got an appointment at AIMA for next month.
words.proTip: AIMA replaced the old SEF in 2023 for residence permits. You'll still hear older people say «o SEF».

words.example: A minha autorização de residência caduca em março.
words.exampleTranslation: My residence permit expires in March.

words.english: certificate of residence (from the parish council)
words.example: Pedi um atestado de residência na junta de freguesia.
words.exampleTranslation: I asked for a certificate of residence at the parish council.
words.proTip: Juntas often ask for two local voters as witnesses, or a contract or bill in your name, before issuing it.

words.example: Para abrir conta no banco, pedem um comprovativo de morada.
words.exampleTranslation: To open a bank account, they ask for proof of address.
words.proTip: Banks and Finanças usually accept a recent utility bill (água, luz, gás) as comprovativo de morada.

words.example: Preciso de uma certidão de nascimento recente para o casamento.
words.exampleTranslation: I need a recent birth certificate for the wedding.
words.proTip: Many offices only accept certidões issued within the last six months. You can order most online.

words.example: A escola pediu-me o registo criminal antes de assinar o contrato.
words.exampleTranslation: The school asked for my criminal record certificate before signing the contract.

words.example: O registo do casamento faz-se na conservatória.
words.exampleTranslation: The marriage is registered at the registry office.

words.example: Os nascimentos e casamentos ficam no registo civil.
words.exampleTranslation: Births and marriages are kept in the civil registry.

words.example: Fomos ao notário para fazer a escritura da casa.
words.exampleTranslation: We went to the notary to sign the house deed.

words.example: O cartório fica aberto até às cinco e meia.
words.exampleTranslation: The notary's office is open until half past five.

words.example: Um solicitador tratou de todos os papéis da herança.
words.exampleTranslation: A solicitor dealt with all the inheritance papers.
words.proTip: In Portugal a solicitador is a separate profession from advogado, often cheaper for paperwork like certifying documents or registering property.

words.example: Deixei uma procuração ao meu irmão para assinar por mim.
words.exampleTranslation: I left my brother power of attorney to sign for me.

words.example: Tens de reconhecer a assinatura num notário ou advogado.
words.exampleTranslation: You have to get the signature certified at a notary or lawyer.
words.proTip: Lawyers, solicitadores, notaries and some post offices can do it; bring your ID and sign in front of them.

words.example: Não aceitam fotocópias simples, só cópias autenticadas.
words.exampleTranslation: They don't accept plain photocopies, only certified copies.

words.example: Leva duas fotografias tipo passe recentes.
words.exampleTranslation: Bring two recent passport-style photos.

words.example: Entreguei o requerimento na câmara municipal na semana passada.
words.exampleTranslation: I handed in the application at the town hall last week.

words.english: to apply for, to request formally
words.example: Pode requerer o apoio através do site da Segurança Social.
words.exampleTranslation: You can apply for the benefit through the Social Security website.
words.proTip: Requerer is formal; in conversation people just say pedir.

words.example: O requerente deve assinar na última página.
words.exampleTranslation: The applicant must sign on the last page.

words.example: Boa notícia: o meu pedido foi deferido!
words.exampleTranslation: Good news: my application was approved!
words.proTip: Official letters say deferido / indeferido rather than aprovado / recusado.

words.example: Qual é o número do seu processo?
words.exampleTranslation: What's your case number?

words.example: Passei a manhã toda a tratar da papelada do carro.
words.exampleTranslation: I spent the whole morning dealing with the car paperwork.

words.example: A burocracia em Portugal às vezes é de loucos.
words.exampleTranslation: Bureaucracy in Portugal is sometimes insane.

words.example: Fui à repartição de Finanças do meu bairro.
words.exampleTranslation: I went to the tax office in my neighbourhood.

words.example: Vim tratar de um assunto da minha pensão.
words.exampleTranslation: I've come to sort out a matter about my pension.
words.proTip: Classic opening at a counter: «Bom dia, vinha tratar de um assunto...» — the imperfect vinha sounds polite.

words.example: Perdi o cartão e tive de pedir uma segunda via.
words.exampleTranslation: I lost the card and had to request a replacement.
words.proTip: Segunda via is used for any reissued document: a lost card, a bill, a receipt.

words.example: Com a Chave Móvel Digital, assino documentos sem sair de casa.
words.exampleTranslation: With the Chave Móvel Digital, I sign documents without leaving home.
words.proTip: It links your phone to your ID and lets you log into Finanças, Segurança Social and SNS sites. Worth activating early.

words.english: to go to, to head to (formal)
words.example: Senha A42, dirija-se ao balcão cinco.
words.exampleTranslation: Ticket A42, please go to counter five.

words.example: Aguarde um momento, vou verificar no sistema.
words.exampleTranslation: Please wait a moment, I'll check the system.
words.proTip: Aguardar is the formal word you'll see on screens and hear from clerks; esperar is the everyday one.

words.english: in order of arrival, first come first served
words.example: Sem marcação, o atendimento é por ordem de chegada.
words.exampleTranslation: Without an appointment, service is first come, first served.

words.example: As grávidas e os idosos têm atendimento prioritário.
words.exampleTranslation: Pregnant women and the elderly get priority service.
words.proTip: By law, pregnant women, people over 65, people with disabilities and adults with babies get priority at counters.

words.example: Na naturalidade, ponho a cidade onde nasci?
words.exampleTranslation: Under 'naturalidade', do I put the city where I was born?
words.proTip: Don't confuse with nacionalidade: naturalidade is where you were born (town or country).

words.example: Preencha o formulário em maiúsculas e com caneta azul.
words.exampleTranslation: Fill in the form in capital letters with a blue pen.

words.example: Tem de anexar uma cópia do contrato ao pedido.
words.exampleTranslation: You have to attach a copy of the contract to the application.

words.example: Podes digitalizar o documento e enviar por email?
words.exampleTranslation: Can you scan the document and send it by email?

words.example: Verifica a validade do cartão antes de viajar.
words.exampleTranslation: Check your card's expiry date before travelling.

words.example: Não posso viajar, tenho o passaporte caducado.
words.exampleTranslation: I can't travel, my passport has expired.

words.example: No primeiro ano, os trabalhadores independentes estão isentos de contribuições.
words.exampleTranslation: In the first year, self-employed workers are exempt from contributions.

words.example: A empresa passou-me uma declaração de que trabalho lá.
words.exampleTranslation: The company gave me a letter confirming that I work there.

words.example: Tive de ir à agência porque a app não funcionava.
words.exampleTranslation: I had to go to the branch because the app wasn't working.

words.example: O ordenado cai na conta à ordem no dia 25.
words.exampleTranslation: My salary goes into the current account on the 25th.

words.example: Todos os meses ponho cem euros na conta poupança.
words.exampleTranslation: Every month I put a hundred euros in the savings account.

words.example: Só o titular da conta pode fazer esta alteração.
words.exampleTranslation: Only the account holder can make this change.

words.example: Liguei ao meu gestor de conta para perguntar pelo crédito.
words.exampleTranslation: I called my account manager to ask about the loan.

words.example: Fiz a transferência pelo homebanking em dois minutos.
words.exampleTranslation: I made the transfer through online banking in two minutes.
words.proTip: Portuguese banks really do use the English word homebanking for their online services.

words.example: A conta da luz é paga por débito direto.
words.exampleTranslation: The electricity bill is paid by direct debit.
words.proTip: Many companies give a small discount if you pay by débito direto and receive fatura eletrónica.

words.example: Pagamentos acima de três mil euros não podem ser feitos em numerário.
words.exampleTranslation: Payments over three thousand euros can't be made in cash.

words.example: Podes pagar por referência no multibanco ou na app do banco.
words.exampleTranslation: You can pay by reference at the ATM or in your bank app.
words.proTip: Bills and online shops give you an entidade (5 digits), a referência (9 digits) and an amount; you enter them under «Pagamentos de serviços».

words.example: Primeiro introduz a entidade, depois a referência e o valor.
words.exampleTranslation: First enter the entity number, then the reference and the amount.

words.example: Entreguei o IRS fora de prazo e apanhei uma coima.
words.exampleTranslation: I filed my tax return late and got a fine.
words.proTip: Coima is the fine from public bodies like Finanças; multa is the general word, e.g. for parking or a speeding ticket.

words.example: Se pagares depois do prazo, há juros de mora.
words.exampleTranslation: If you pay after the deadline, there's late interest.

words.example: Tenho duas faturas em atraso, tenho de pagar hoje.
words.exampleTranslation: I've got two overdue bills, I have to pay today.

words.example: O pedido foi recusado porque o entreguei fora de prazo.
words.exampleTranslation: The application was refused because I handed it in late.

words.example: O banco cobra cinco euros por mês de manutenção.
words.exampleTranslation: The bank charges five euros a month in maintenance fees.

words.example: A mensalidade do ginásio sobe em janeiro.
words.exampleTranslation: The gym's monthly fee goes up in January.

words.example: Passo uma fatura-recibo no Portal das Finanças depois de cada trabalho.
words.exampleTranslation: I issue an invoice-receipt on the Portal das Finanças after every job.
words.proTip: This is the modern version of the «recibo verde» that self-employed people issue through the Finanças website.

words.example: O IMI paga-se em maio, ou em prestações ao longo do ano.
words.exampleTranslation: IMI is paid in May, or in instalments over the year.

words.example: Vou aos CTT enviar isto por correio registado.
words.exampleTranslation: I'm going to the post office to send this by registered mail.
words.proTip: People say «vou aos CTT» and «vou aos correios» interchangeably. CTT stands for Correios, Telégrafos e Telefones.

words.example: As Finanças mandaram-me uma carta registada.
words.exampleTranslation: Finanças sent me a registered letter.
words.proTip: If you're not home, the postman leaves an aviso and you collect the letter at the post office within a set number of days.

words.example: Envia a carta registada com aviso de receção para teres prova.
words.exampleTranslation: Send the letter registered with proof of delivery so you have proof.
words.proTip: Often written «AR». Essential when terminating contracts or sending notice to a landlord.

words.example: Tenho de levantar uma encomenda nos correios até sexta.
words.exampleTranslation: I have to collect a parcel at the post office by Friday.

words.example: Não reconheço o remetente desta carta.
words.exampleTranslation: I don't recognise the sender of this letter.

words.example: Escreve o nome do destinatário no meio do envelope.
words.exampleTranslation: Write the recipient's name in the middle of the envelope.

words.example: Deixei a carta no marco do correio ao pé de casa.
words.exampleTranslation: I dropped the letter in the postbox near home.
words.proTip: Portuguese postboxes are red; the blue ones are for «correio azul», the faster priority service.

words.example: Mandaram-me o número de seguimento por email.
words.exampleTranslation: They sent me the tracking number by email.

words.example: A loja faz entregas ao domicílio sem custos.
words.exampleTranslation: The shop does free home delivery.

words.example: A encomenda ficou num ponto de recolha perto do metro.
words.exampleTranslation: The parcel was left at a pickup point near the metro.

words.example: Lê bem esta cláusula antes de assinares.
words.exampleTranslation: Read this clause carefully before you sign.

words.example: Este tarifário tem uma fidelização de 24 meses.
words.exampleTranslation: This plan has a 24-month lock-in period.
words.proTip: Phone, internet and TV contracts in Portugal usually have fidelização; leaving early means paying a penalty.

words.example: Ninguém lê os termos e condições até ao fim.
words.exampleTranslation: Nobody reads the terms and conditions to the end.

words.example: Tem de rubricar todas as páginas e assinar a última.
words.exampleTranslation: You have to initial every page and sign the last one.
words.proTip: Portuguese contracts are normally initialled on every page, not just signed at the end.

words.example: O montante em dívida é de 230 euros.
words.exampleTranslation: The amount owed is 230 euros.

words.example: Se não resolverem, peço o livro de reclamações.
words.exampleTranslation: If they don't sort it out, I'll ask for the complaints book.
words.proTip: Every business and public service must have one and hand it over on request. Just asking for it often solves the problem.

words.example: A data de vencimento da fatura é dia 15.
words.exampleTranslation: The bill's due date is the 15th.

words.example: Liguei para a linha de apoio e fiquei quarenta minutos à espera.
words.exampleTranslation: I called the helpline and was on hold for forty minutes.

categories.title: Renting & Home Life
categories.description: Renting a flat, landlords, bills, repairs and living with neighbours

words.example: O senhorio vem cá amanhã ver o esquentador.
words.exampleTranslation: The landlord is coming round tomorrow to look at the water heater.
words.proTip: In Portugal "senhorio" is the standard word in contracts and conversation; "proprietário" sounds more formal.

words.example: Os inquilinos do segundo andar mudaram-se no mês passado.
words.exampleTranslation: The tenants on the second floor moved out last month.

words.example: Arrendámos um T2 em Arroios por dois anos.
words.exampleTranslation: We rented a two-bedroom flat in Arroios for two years.
words.proTip: "Arrendar" works both ways: the landlord "arrenda" the flat to you, and you "arrendas" it from him. Signs say "Arrenda-se".

words.example: Estou à procura de um T1 perto do metro.
words.exampleTranslation: I'm looking for a one-bedroom flat near the metro.
words.proTip: The number after T counts bedrooms only, not the living room: a T2 has two bedrooms plus a sala.

words.example: Moramos no rés-do-chão, por isso não precisamos de elevador.
words.exampleTranslation: We live on the ground floor, so we don't need a lift.
words.proTip: In addresses it's shortened to "r/c", e.g. "Rua X, 12, r/c esq." (ground floor, left).

words.example: Os vizinhos de cima fazem imenso barulho à noite.
words.exampleTranslation: The upstairs neighbours make a huge amount of noise at night.

words.example: A chave já não roda bem na fechadura.
words.exampleTranslation: The key doesn't turn properly in the lock any more.

words.example: A casa não tem aquecimento central, só um aquecedor elétrico.
words.exampleTranslation: The house has no central heating, just an electric heater.
words.proTip: Most older Portuguese flats have no central heating, so winters indoors can feel colder than in northern Europe. Ask about it on viewings.

words.example: No verão ligamos o ar condicionado no quarto.
words.exampleTranslation: In summer we turn on the air conditioning in the bedroom.

words.example: Vi o apartamento no site de uma imobiliária.
words.exampleTranslation: I saw the flat on an estate agency's website.

words.example: Prefiro um apartamento mobilado, porque não tenho móveis.
words.exampleTranslation: I'd rather have a furnished flat because I don't have furniture.
words.proTip: Portugal uses "mobilado"; "mobiliado" is the Brazilian form.

words.example: O fogão é a gás, mas o forno é elétrico.
words.exampleTranslation: The hob runs on gas, but the oven is electric.

words.example: Temos de chamar um eletricista, as tomadas da cozinha não funcionam.
words.exampleTranslation: We need to call an electrician, the kitchen sockets don't work.

words.example: Pago a renda por transferência até dia oito.
words.exampleTranslation: I pay the rent by bank transfer by the eighth.
words.proTip: Landlords must issue an electronic rent receipt on the Portal das Finanças each month; you need it for your IRS deductions.

words.example: Vamos visitar um apartamento em Benfica no sábado.
words.exampleTranslation: We're going to view a flat in Benfica on Saturday.

words.example: Partilho casa com duas colegas da faculdade.
words.exampleTranslation: I share a flat with two friends from university.

words.example: A minha colega de casa trabalha de noite.
words.exampleTranslation: My flatmate works nights.

words.example: Fundiu-se a lâmpada da casa de banho.
words.exampleTranslation: The bathroom light bulb has blown.

words.example: A torneira da cozinha está sempre a pingar.
words.exampleTranslation: The kitchen tap is always dripping.

words.example: Fecha o estore, o sol está a bater no ecrã.
words.exampleTranslation: Close the shutter, the sun is hitting the screen.
words.proTip: Almost every Portuguese flat has external roller shutters; a broken "estore" is one of the most common repair requests.

words.example: O nosso prédio não tem elevador, só escadas.
words.exampleTranslation: Our building has no lift, only stairs.

words.example: Os meus sogros vivem numa moradia com jardim.
words.exampleTranslation: My in-laws live in a detached house with a garden.

words.example: O senhorio prometeu reparar o estore esta semana.
words.exampleTranslation: The landlord promised to repair the shutter this week.
words.proTip: Careful: "reparar" also means "to notice" ("reparar em"): "Reparaste no bolor?" = Did you notice the mould?

words.example: A máquina de lavar está avariada outra vez.
words.exampleTranslation: The washing machine is broken down again.

words.example: A mobília da sala já vinha com o apartamento.
words.exampleTranslation: The living-room furniture came with the flat.

words.example: Um T0 no centro de Lisboa custa uma fortuna.
words.exampleTranslation: A studio in central Lisbon costs a fortune.

words.example: Pediram dois meses de caução e um de renda adiantada.
words.exampleTranslation: They asked for two months' deposit and one month's rent upfront.
words.proTip: Typical in Lisbon: one or two months' caução plus one or two months' rent in advance. Get the flat's condition in writing so you get the caução back.

words.example: Sem fiador, o senhorio pediu mais um mês de caução.
words.exampleTranslation: Without a guarantor, the landlord asked for an extra month's deposit.
words.proTip: Many landlords want a Portuguese-resident fiador; foreigners without one often pay extra months up front instead.

words.example: Lê bem o contrato de arrendamento antes de assinar.
words.exampleTranslation: Read the tenancy agreement carefully before you sign.
words.proTip: The landlord must register the contract with Finanças; ask for proof, as you need it for your address and tax deductions.

words.english: the main room (bedroom or living room)
words.example: É um apartamento de três assoalhadas, perto da Avenida de Roma.
words.exampleTranslation: It's a three-room flat near Avenida de Roma.
words.proTip: An "assoalhada" counts bedrooms and living rooms but not the kitchen or bathroom, so "três assoalhadas" usually equals a T2.

words.english: the building's owners' association / service charge
words.example: O condomínio está incluído na renda?
words.exampleTranslation: Is the building service charge included in the rent?
words.proTip: "Condomínio" means both the owners' association of a building and the fee they pay. In Portugal it's normally the owner's cost, not the tenant's.

words.example: Liga para a administração do condomínio por causa do elevador.
words.exampleTranslation: Call the building management about the lift.

words.example: Deixaram a encomenda na portaria do prédio.
words.exampleTranslation: They left the parcel at the building's reception desk.

words.example: O contador da luz fica na entrada do prédio.
words.exampleTranslation: The electricity meter is in the building's entrance.

words.example: Quando me mudei, demoraram uma semana a ligar a luz.
words.exampleTranslation: When I moved in, it took a week to get the electricity connected.
words.proTip: Context matters: "ligar a luz" also simply means "switch on the light". When moving, people say "ligar a luz/água/gás" for setting up the supply in their name.

words.example: Envia a leitura do contador para não pagares por estimativa.
words.exampleTranslation: Send the meter reading so you don't pay an estimated bill.
words.proTip: Water and gas companies bill by estimate unless you send readings, often via app or SMS on set days of the month.

words.example: Já comuniquei a avaria do esquentador ao senhorio.
words.exampleTranslation: I've already reported the water heater fault to the landlord.

words.example: Há uma fuga de água por baixo do lava-loiça.
words.exampleTranslation: There's a water leak under the kitchen sink.

words.example: No inverno, as paredes do quarto ficam cheias de humidade.
words.exampleTranslation: In winter, the bedroom walls get covered in damp.
words.proTip: Damp is a classic problem in Lisbon's older flats. Many people run a "desumidificador" all winter.

words.example: Apareceu bolor no teto da casa de banho.
words.exampleTranslation: Mould has appeared on the bathroom ceiling.

words.example: O prédio ao lado está em obras desde março.
words.exampleTranslation: The building next door has been under renovation since March.
words.proTip: Noise from obras is restricted to weekdays 8:00–20:00 under Portuguese noise law — useful to know when you complain.

words.example: Contratámos uma empresa de mudanças para levar os móveis.
words.exampleTranslation: We hired a removal company to take the furniture.

words.example: O apartamento tem uma arrecadação na cave.
words.exampleTranslation: The flat comes with a storage room in the basement.

words.example: A renda inclui lugar de garagem?
words.exampleTranslation: Does the rent include a parking space?

words.example: Este prédio é antigo e não tem isolamento nenhum.
words.exampleTranslation: This building is old and has no insulation at all.

words.example: O frigorífico avariou mesmo antes das férias.
words.exampleTranslation: The fridge broke down just before the holidays.

words.example: Temos de entregar as chaves até ao fim do mês.
words.exampleTranslation: We have to hand over the keys by the end of the month.

words.example: O esquentador não acende, por isso não há água quente.
words.exampleTranslation: The water heater won't light, so there's no hot water.
words.proTip: Many Portuguese flats heat water with a gas "esquentador" in the kitchen; it needs a yearly check and must not be in a closed room.

words.example: Ligamos o aquecedor a óleo só à noite, por causa da conta.
words.exampleTranslation: We only switch on the oil heater at night because of the bill.

words.example: A infiltração vem do apartamento de cima.
words.exampleTranslation: The leak is coming from the flat upstairs.

words.example: O lava-loiça está entupido outra vez.
words.exampleTranslation: The kitchen sink is blocked again.

words.example: Rebentou um cano e a cozinha ficou inundada.
words.exampleTranslation: A pipe burst and the kitchen flooded.

words.example: A luz foi abaixo; vai ver o quadro elétrico.
words.exampleTranslation: The power's gone off; go and check the fuse box.

words.example: Antes de pintar, vamos pedir um orçamento a duas empresas.
words.exampleTranslation: Before painting, we'll ask two companies for a quote.

words.example: A quota do condomínio subiu por causa das obras no telhado.
words.exampleTranslation: The service charge went up because of the roof works.

words.example: Para sair, tenho de dar dois meses de aviso prévio.
words.exampleTranslation: To leave, I have to give two months' notice.

relatedWords.meaning: to give notice on the contract

words.proTip: Notice to end a tenancy is normally sent by "carta registada com aviso de receção" — an email isn't enough legally.

words.example: O senhorio não quer renovar o contrato no próximo ano.
words.exampleTranslation: The landlord doesn't want to renew the contract next year.

words.example: Se rescindires o contrato antes, perdes a caução.
words.exampleTranslation: If you terminate the contract early, you lose the deposit.

words.example: Com três meses de renda em atraso, pode haver despejo.
words.exampleTranslation: With three months' rent overdue, there can be an eviction.

words.example: O quarto custa quinhentos euros com despesas incluídas.
words.exampleTranslation: The room costs five hundred euros with bills included.

words.example: O anúncio diz que o certificado energético é classe C.
words.exampleTranslation: The ad says the energy certificate is class C.
words.proTip: Every flat advertised for rent or sale in Portugal must show its energy class; a low letter (E or F) usually means a cold, damp winter.

words.example: A sala é muito soalheira de manhã.
words.exampleTranslation: The living room gets lots of sun in the morning.

words.example: Procuro um apartamento luminoso, com janelas grandes.
words.exampleTranslation: I'm looking for a bright flat with big windows.

words.example: O quarto é pequeno mas bem arejado.
words.exampleTranslation: The bedroom is small but well ventilated.

words.example: A cozinha é espaçosa e tem despensa.
words.exampleTranslation: The kitchen is spacious and has a pantry.

words.example: É um T2 remodelado, com cozinha nova.
words.exampleTranslation: It's a renovated two-bedroom flat with a new kitchen.

words.example: Liguei para a imobiliária para agendar uma visita.
words.exampleTranslation: I called the agency to schedule a viewing.

words.example: O meu pai ajudou-me a consertar o estore.
words.exampleTranslation: My dad helped me fix the shutter.

words.example: Tens de arranjar alguém para arranjar a torneira.
words.exampleTranslation: You need to find someone to fix the tap.

relatedWords.meaning: to find a place to live

words.proTip: "Arranjar" is very common in Portugal: "arranjar casa" = find a home, "arranjar a máquina" = fix the machine.

words.example: Acabou o gás, temos de trocar a botija.
words.exampleTranslation: We've run out of gas, we need to swap the cylinder.
words.proTip: Buildings without mains gas use bottled gas: you swap the empty "botija" at a petrol station or have it delivered.

words.example: Põe o estendal na varanda, está um dia de sol.
words.exampleTranslation: Put the drying rack on the balcony, it's a sunny day.

words.example: Desculpe incomodar, mas a música está muito alta.
words.exampleTranslation: Sorry to bother you, but the music is very loud.

words.example: O regulamento proíbe ruído depois das onze da noite.
words.exampleTranslation: The rules forbid noise after eleven at night.
words.proTip: "Ruído" is the official word (Regulamento Geral do Ruído); in conversation people say "barulho".

words.example: Fechámos a varanda e agora temos uma marquise.
words.exampleTranslation: We enclosed the balcony and now we have a sunroom.

words.example: O apartamento tem cozinha equipada com forno e placa.
words.exampleTranslation: The flat has a fitted kitchen with an oven and hob.

words.example: O intercomunicador está avariado; liga-me quando chegares.
words.exampleTranslation: The intercom is broken; call me when you arrive.

words.example: Perdi as chaves e tive de trocar a fechadura.
words.exampleTranslation: I lost my keys and had to change the lock.

words.example: Há um ecoponto mesmo à porta do prédio.
words.exampleTranslation: There's a recycling point right outside the building.
words.proTip: Colours: yellow for plastic and metal, blue for paper and cardboard, green for glass.

words.example: Os moradores do prédio fizeram queixa do barulho.
words.exampleTranslation: The building's residents complained about the noise.

words.example: Na assembleia de condomínio decidiram pintar a fachada.
words.exampleTranslation: At the residents' meeting they decided to paint the façade.

categories.title: News & Society
categories.description: Government, elections, work, housing and the words you read in the news

words.example: Os meus pais jantam sempre a ver o telejornal.
words.exampleTranslation: My parents always have dinner watching the TV news.
words.proTip: "Telejornal" is also the name of RTP1's main evening news at 8 p.m., a dinner-time ritual in many Portuguese homes.

words.example: O governo vai apresentar novas medidas esta semana.
words.exampleTranslation: The government is going to present new measures this week.

words.example: O primeiro-ministro falou aos jornalistas depois da reunião.
words.exampleTranslation: The prime minister spoke to journalists after the meeting.
words.proTip: In Portugal the prime minister runs the government; the President is head of state and has a more limited role.

words.example: O Presidente da República promulgou a lei ontem.
words.exampleTranslation: The President signed the law into force yesterday.
words.proTip: The President is elected directly for five years. News often just says "Belém" for the presidency, the way "São Bento" means parliament and the PM's residence.

words.example: As eleições são no domingo e as escolas servem de mesa de voto.
words.exampleTranslation: The elections are on Sunday and schools are used as polling stations.

words.example: Ainda não decidi em quem vou votar.
words.exampleTranslation: I still haven't decided who I'm going to vote for.

words.example: O voto é secreto e ninguém te pode perguntar em quem votaste.
words.exampleTranslation: The vote is secret and nobody can ask you who you voted for.

words.example: Há muitos partidos com deputados no parlamento.
words.exampleTranslation: There are many parties with MPs in parliament.
words.proTip: Careful: "partido" is also the past participle of "partir" — "o copo está partido" means the glass is broken.

words.example: A nova lei entra em vigor no próximo mês.
words.exampleTranslation: The new law comes into force next month.

words.example: Amanhã há greve dos comboios, por isso vou de autocarro.
words.exampleTranslation: There's a train strike tomorrow, so I'm taking the bus.
words.proTip: Strikes are announced in advance with "serviços mínimos"; check the CP or Metro site the day before.

words.example: Ela arranjou emprego numa empresa de tecnologia em Lisboa.
words.exampleTranslation: She got a job at a tech company in Lisbon.

words.example: O desemprego entre os jovens continua a preocupar muita gente.
words.exampleTranslation: Youth unemployment continues to worry a lot of people.

words.example: Durante a crise, muitos jovens foram trabalhar para o estrangeiro.
words.exampleTranslation: During the crisis, many young people went to work abroad.

words.example: O turismo é muito importante para a economia do Algarve.
words.exampleTranslation: Tourism is very important for the Algarve's economy.

words.example: No verão, a Baixa está cheia de turistas.
words.exampleTranslation: In summer, the Baixa is full of tourists.

words.example: Muitos imigrantes trabalham na restauração e na construção.
words.exampleTranslation: Many immigrants work in restaurants and construction.

words.example: Os preços da comida aumentaram muito este ano.
words.exampleTranslation: Food prices went up a lot this year.

words.example: Lá em casa não falamos de política ao jantar.
words.exampleTranslation: At home we don't talk about politics at dinner.
words.proTip: "A política" covers both politics and a specific policy: "a política de habitação" is housing policy.

words.example: Viste o debate entre os candidatos ontem à noite?
words.exampleTranslation: Did you watch the debate between the candidates last night?

words.example: O preço das casas em Lisboa não para de subir.
words.exampleTranslation: House prices in Lisbon keep going up.
words.proTip: Prices are usually quoted per metro quadrado (m²) in the news.

words.example: A greve dos professores fez a manchete de todos os jornais.
words.exampleTranslation: The teachers' strike was the headline in every newspaper.

words.example: Vi uma reportagem sobre a falta de médicos no interior.
words.exampleTranslation: I saw a report on the shortage of doctors inland.

words.example: O jogo e o discurso do Presidente vão ser transmitidos em direto.
words.exampleTranslation: The match and the President's speech will be broadcast live.

words.example: A imprensa estrangeira também falou do caso.
words.exampleTranslation: The foreign press also covered the story.

words.example: O ministro deu uma conferência de imprensa ao fim da tarde.
words.exampleTranslation: The minister gave a press conference in the late afternoon.

words.example: Os comentadores passaram a noite a analisar os resultados.
words.exampleTranslation: The pundits spent the night analysing the results.
words.proTip: Political commentary is a huge genre on Portuguese TV; Sunday-night commentators are household names.

words.example: A proposta vai ser votada na Assembleia da República.
words.exampleTranslation: The proposal will be voted on in Parliament.

words.example: Os deputados discutiram o tema durante horas.
words.exampleTranslation: The MPs discussed the issue for hours.

words.example: O presidente da câmara prometeu mais ciclovias na cidade.
words.exampleTranslation: The mayor promised more cycle lanes in the city.
words.proTip: Portugal has no word "mayor" in everyday use — people say "o presidente da câmara".

words.example: Fui à junta de freguesia pedir um atestado de residência.
words.exampleTranslation: I went to the parish council to ask for a certificate of residence.
words.proTip: The junta is the most local level of government and the place to get an atestado de residência, often needed for bureaucracy.

words.example: Nas autárquicas, escolhemos a câmara e a junta de freguesia.
words.exampleTranslation: In local elections, we choose the city council and the parish council.
words.proTip: Foreign residents from some countries, including EU citizens, can vote in autárquicas if registered.

words.example: As legislativas decidem quem forma o próximo governo.
words.exampleTranslation: The general elections decide who forms the next government.

words.example: Durante a campanha eleitoral, há cartazes por todo o lado.
words.exampleTranslation: During the election campaign, there are posters everywhere.

words.example: Cada candidato teve dez minutos para apresentar as suas ideias.
words.exampleTranslation: Each candidate had ten minutes to present their ideas.

words.example: Segundo a última sondagem, a abstenção pode ser alta.
